description: This file defines the FavoriteStore class, which provides in-memory persistence of favorite recipes using Android's SharedPreferences. It exposes methods to get all favorites, check if a recipe is favorite, add, remove by ID, and singleton instance management. It manages favorite recipes with associated IDs, titles, and images, and ensures data persistence across app sessions.

classes.name: FavoriteStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing favorite recipes with in-memory and SharedPreferences persistence, providing methods to add, remove, and query favorite recipes.

methods.name: readFromPrefs
methods.description: Reads favorite recipes from SharedPreferences and returns a list of FavoriteRecipe objects.

methods.name: writeToPrefs
methods.description: Writes the current list of favorite recipes to SharedPreferences, updating keys accordingly.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a LiveData object containing the list of all favorite recipes.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a recipe with the given ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a FavoriteRecipe to the favorites list if it isn't already present.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Removes a FavoriteRecipe from the favorites list by its ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of FavoriteStore, initializing it if necessary.
